records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#1

records.source: The strip sits directly above the Run button of a pipeline screen and shows three things:
records.translation: Ræman er beint fyrir ofan Run-hnapp vinnslulagnarskjás og sýnir þrennt:

records.context: **what it will read.**  :mod:`spacr.chaining` asks the artifact registry where the previous module actually wrote and fills this module's source folder with it, so Measure opened after Mask has the laboratory microplate folder filled in.  A path the user typed themselves is *pinned* and never overwritten — when the upstream later moves, the new location is offered beside the pinned one with a button, never pushed into the microscope field of view;
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **what it will read.**  :mod:`spacr.chaining` asks the artifact registry where the previous module actually wrote and fills this module's source folder with it, so Measure opened after Mask has the plate folder filled in.  A path the user typed themselves is *pinned* and never overwritten — when the upstream later moves, the new location is offered beside the pinned one with a button, never pushed into the field;
records.translation: **hvað hún mun lesa.**  :mod:`spacr.chaining` spyr afurðaskrána hvert fyrri eining skrifaði í raun og fyllir upprunamöppu þessarar einingar með því, svo Measure sem opnuð er á eftir Mask er með plötumöppuna útfyllta.  Slóð sem notandinn sló sjálfur inn er *fest* og aldrei skrifað yfir hana — þegar uppstreymið færist síðar er nýja staðsetningin boðin við hlið þeirrar festu með hnappi, aldrei þrýst inn í reitinn;

records.context: **what is out of date.**  :func:`spacr.chaining.staleness_notes` turns the registry's cause codes into a sentence and a fix, so "these measurements came from a Mask run you have since redone" is on application view *before* the figure is opened rather than discovered afterwards;
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **what is out of date.**  :func:`spacr.chaining.staleness_notes` turns the registry's cause codes into a sentence and a fix, so "these measurements came from a Mask run you have since redone" is on screen *before* the figure is opened rather than discovered afterwards;
records.translation: **hvað er úrelt.**  :func:`spacr.chaining.staleness_notes` breytir orsakakóðum skrárinnar í setningu og lagfæringu, svo "these measurements came from a Mask run you have since redone" (þessar mælingar komu úr Mask-keyrslu sem þú hefur síðan endurtekið) er á skjánum *áður* en myndin er opnuð frekar en að uppgötvast eftir á;

records.context: **what comes next.**  A finished processing session offers its successors from :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules`, each pre-filled with the artifact just produced and each checked with :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` — so an offer either works, or is shown greyed with the reason it cannot.
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **what comes next.**  A finished run offers its successors from :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules`, each pre-filled with the artifact just produced and each checked with :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` — so an offer either works, or is shown greyed with the reason it cannot.
records.translation: **hvað kemur næst.**  Lokin keyrsla býður arftaka sína úr :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules`, hvern útfylltan með afurðinni sem rétt var framleidd og hvern athugaðan með :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` — svo tilboð annaðhvort virkar, eða er sýnt gráskyggt með ástæðunni fyrir því að það getur það ekki.

records.context: A stroke is dozens of ``move`` events and exactly one thing the user did. :meth:`BrushTool.press` opens a stroke, :meth:`BrushTool.release` closes it, and undo takes back the stroke — not the last few pixels of it. That is the whole reason ``CanvasTool`` grew a ``release`` hook.
records.label: spacr.qt.curation_tool#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A stroke is dozens of ``move`` events and exactly one thing the user did. :meth:`BrushTool.press` opens a stroke, :meth:`BrushTool.release` closes it, and undo takes back the stroke — not the last few pixels of it. That is the whole reason ``CanvasTool`` grew a ``release`` hook.
records.translation: Stroka er tugir ``move`` atburða og nákvæmlega eitt sem notandinn gerði. :meth:`BrushTool.press` opnar stroku, :meth:`BrushTool.release` lokar henni, og afturköllun tekur strokuna til baka — ekki síðustu dílana í henni. Það er öll ástæðan fyrir því að ``CanvasTool`` fékk ``release`` krók.

records.translation: Qt afhendir slepp á GUI-þræðinum og hver slóð í því er slóð sem NOTANDINN valdi -- sem gæti verið á ``autofs`` drifi í dvala sem tekur meira en tuttugu sekúndur að svara einu stat (sjá :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`). records.context: :func:`retranslate_widget_tree` safely updates already-created static Qt labels, buttons, menus, tabs, combo-box choices and accessibility text. Upprunalegir enskir strengir eru geymdir sem kvikir Qt-eiginleikar, svo gluggi getur skipt úr sænsku yfir í kóresku (til dæmis) án þess að þýða þýðingu. Breytanleg gildi og slóðir sem notandinn sló inn eru aldrei snert.

records.translation: ``only_new`` er sjálfgefið óvirkt. records.context: Every vertex is a world coordinate taken from :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at`, and the polygon being drawn is a real :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape` in a real :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer`. So the half-finished ROI is rendered by the same compositor as everything else, it survives a zoom, and the finished ROI is already in the form :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer` reads. Nothing about the drawing is in pixels, which is what lets an ROI drawn on a downsampled preview name the same region on a full-resolution mask.
records.label: spacr.qt.roi_tool#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Every vertex is a world coordinate taken from :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at`, and the polygon being drawn is a real :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape` in a real :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer`. So the half-finished ROI is rendered by the same compositor as everything else, it survives a zoom, and the finished ROI is already in the form :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer` reads. Nothing about the drawing is in pixels, which is what lets an ROI drawn on a downsampled preview name the same region on a full-resolution mask.
records.translation: Hver hornpunktur er heimshnit tekið úr :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at`, og marghyrningurinn sem verið er að teikna er raunverulegt :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape` í raunverulegu :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer`. Því er hálfklárað ROI myndað af sama samsetjara og allt annað, það lifir af aðdrátt, og fullgert ROI er þegar á því formi sem :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer` les. Ekkert við teikninguna er í dílum, sem er það sem leyfir ROI teiknuðu á niðursýnda forskoðun að nefna sama svæði á grímu í fullri upplausn.

records.context: Switching the filter on is one call. The panel shows whether the filter will reach the worker processes that do the measuring: a filter registered only in the GUI process has no effect in a ``spawn`` worker, and the processing session then measures whole fields without a warning. :func:`spacr.roi.worker_delivery_status` reports this in advance, and the panel shows the result in the warning colour when the filter will not reach the workers.
records.label: spacr.qt.roi_tool#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Switching the filter on is one call. The panel shows whether the filter will reach the worker processes that do the measuring: a filter registered only in the GUI process has no effect in a ``spawn`` worker, and the run then measures whole fields without a warning. :func:`spacr.roi.worker_delivery_status` reports this in advance, and the panel shows the result in the warning colour when the filter will not reach the workers.
records.translation: Að kveikja á síunni er eitt kall. Glugginn sýnir hvort sían muni ná til vinnsluferlanna sem framkvæma mælinguna: sía sem aðeins er skráð í GUI-ferlinu hefur engin áhrif í ``spawn`` vinnsluferli, og keyrslan mælir þá heil sjónsvið án viðvörunar. :func:`spacr.roi.worker_delivery_status` tilkynnir þetta fyrirfram, og glugginn sýnir niðurstöðuna í viðvörunarlitnum þegar sían mun ekki ná til vinnsluferlanna.

records.context: So the widget waits :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_spinner_delay` seconds (default 2) before showing. The mechanism is a **delay, not a prediction**: :meth:`ActivitySpinner._sync` starts a single-shot timer the moment work begins and the spinner becomes visible only if :meth:`ActivitySpinner.is_busy` is *still* true when that timer fires. A job that finishes at 1.9 s cancels the timer on its way out and never puts anything on application view -- no duration is estimated.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#14
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: So the widget waits :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_spinner_delay` seconds (default 2) before showing. The mechanism is a **delay, not a prediction**: :meth:`ActivitySpinner._sync` starts a single-shot timer the moment work begins and the spinner becomes visible only if :meth:`ActivitySpinner.is_busy` is *still* true when that timer fires. A job that finishes at 1.9 s cancels the timer on its way out and never puts anything on screen -- no duration is estimated.
records.translation: Því bíður græjan í :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_spinner_delay` sekúndur (sjálfgefið 2) áður en hún birtist. Kerfið er **töf, ekki spá**: :meth:`ActivitySpinner._sync` ræsir einskotsteljara um leið og vinna hefst og snúningsvísirinn verður aðeins sýnilegur ef :meth:`ActivitySpinner.is_busy` er *enn* satt þegar teljarinn fer af stað. Verk sem lýkur á 1.9 s hættir við teljarann á útleið sinni og setur aldrei neitt á skjáinn -- engin lengd er metin.

records.context: The clock executes on the *work*, not on the job. A second job starting while the timer is pending does not restart it: the timer is armed on the idle-to-busy edge only, so two seconds of continuous background activity shows the spinner even if no single job lasted that long. Going idle disarms it, and the next burst of work starts a fresh two seconds.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#15

records.translation: Klukkan gengur á *vinnunni*, ekki á verkinu. records.context: **Size.** 800x600, 144 frames, 682 KB on disk. ``QMovie`` decodes a frame to a 32-bit ``QImage``, so one frame is 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB and the whole loop is 276 MB. ``QMovie.CacheAll`` holds all of it; ``CacheNone`` (the default) trades that for re-decoding 1.92 MB, and rescaling it to 16 px, 33 times a second, forever.

records.source: **Size.** 800x600, 144 frames, 682 KB on disk. ``QMovie`` decodes a frame to a 32-bit ``QImage``, so one frame is 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB and the whole loop is 276 MB. ``QMovie.CacheAll`` holds all of it; ``CacheNone`` (the default) trades that for re-decoding 1.92 MB, and rescaling it to 16 px, 33 times a second, forever.
records.translation: **Stærð.** 800x600, 144 rammar, 682 KB á diski. ``QMovie`` afkóðar ramma í 32-bit ``QImage``, svo einn rammi er 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB og öll lykkjan er 276 MB. ``QMovie.CacheAll`` heldur öllu þessu; ``CacheNone`` (sjálfgefið) skiptir því út fyrir að afkóða 1.92 MB aftur, og kvarða það niður í 16 px, 33 sinnum á sekúndu, endalaust.

records.translation: **Læsileiki.** Mynstrið er 1-2 px hvít stroka á 800 px striga. Kvarðuð niður í 16 px er strokan 0.02 px breið: hún lifir það ekki af, hvort sem mjúk umbreyting er notuð eða ekki.

records.context: Pre-scaling the frames once into ``QPixmap`` objects fixes the per-frame cost but none of the other two, and it still costs a 276 MB decode pass at start-up for a 16 px dot. So the motif is redrawn instead: the GIF's *character* is a thin ring with a double-helix braid travelling around it (see the frames -- the braid sweeps, the ring stays), and that is exactly what :meth:`ActivitySpinner.paintEvent` draws with two ``QPolygonF`` objects. It costs microseconds, it takes its colours from the live palette so it themes in both light and dark, and it is sharp at any size.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Pre-scaling the frames once into ``QPixmap`` objects fixes the per-frame cost but none of the other two, and it still costs a 276 MB decode pass at start-up for a 16 px dot. So the motif is redrawn instead: the GIF's *character* is a thin ring with a double-helix braid travelling around it (see the frames -- the braid sweeps, the ring stays), and that is exactly what :meth:`ActivitySpinner.paintEvent` draws with two ``QPolygonF`` objects. It costs microseconds, it takes its colours from the live palette so it themes in both light and dark, and it is sharp at any size.
records.translation: Að forkvarða rammana einu sinni í ``QPixmap`` hluti lagar kostnaðinn á hvern ramma en hvorugt hinna atriðanna, og kostar samt 276 MB afkóðun við ræsingu fyrir 16 px punkt. Því er mynstrið teiknað upp á nýtt í staðinn: *svipmót* GIF-myndarinnar er þunnur hringur með tvöfaldri gormfléttu sem ferðast um hann (sjá rammana -- fléttan sveiflast, hringurinn er kyrr), og það er nákvæmlega það sem :meth:`ActivitySpinner.paintEvent` teiknar með tveimur ``QPolygonF`` hlutum. Það kostar míkrósekúndur, tekur liti sína úr virka litaspjaldinu svo það fylgir bæði ljósu og dökku þema, og er skarpt í hvaða stærð sem er.

records.context: Three things make the difference between a reveal that feels deliberate and one that fires while you are aiming at something else:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three things make the difference between a reveal that feels deliberate and one that fires while you are aiming at something else:
records.translation: Þrennt gerir gæfumuninn á afhjúpun sem virkar ásetningsbundin og afhjúpun sem fer af stað meðan þú miðar á eitthvað annað:

records.context: **Dwell, not touch.** Entering the strip starts :data:`EdgeDrawer.OPEN_DELAY_MS`; a pointer that crosses the strip on its way somewhere else has left again before the timer fires.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Dwell, not touch.** Entering the strip starts :data:`EdgeDrawer.OPEN_DELAY_MS`; a pointer that crosses the strip on its way somewhere else has left again before the timer fires.
records.translation: **Dvöl, ekki snerting.** Að fara inn í ræmuna ræsir :data:`EdgeDrawer.OPEN_DELAY_MS`; bendill sem fer yfir ræmuna á leið sinni annað hefur farið aftur áður en teljarinn fer af stað.

records.context: **A pin.** Clicking any row while the drawer is open would otherwise race the close animation. :meth:`hold` keeps it open until something explicitly releases it, which is also how the keyboard path works.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A pin.** Clicking any row while the drawer is open would otherwise race the close animation. :meth:`hold` keeps it open until something explicitly releases it, which is also how the keyboard path works.
records.translation: **Festing.** Smellur á hvaða línu sem er meðan skúffan er opin myndi annars keppa við lokunarhreyfinguna. :meth:`hold` heldur henni opinni þar til eitthvað losar hana skýrt, sem er líka hvernig lyklaborðsleiðin virkar.

records.context: **It is not mouse-only.** :meth:`open_for_keyboard` opens the drawer, pins it, and focuses the first row; Escape (or focus leaving the panel) closes it again. The window installs a shortcut for this — a reveal you can only reach by hovering is a reveal a keyboard user cannot reach at all.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **It is not mouse-only.** :meth:`open_for_keyboard` opens the drawer, pins it, and focuses the first row; Escape (or focus leaving the panel) closes it again. The window installs a shortcut for this — a reveal you can only reach by hovering is a reveal a keyboard user cannot reach at all.
records.translation: **Hún er ekki aðeins fyrir mús.** :meth:`open_for_keyboard` opnar skúffuna, festir hana og setur fókus á fyrstu línuna; Escape (eða fókus sem fer úr glugganum) lokar henni aftur. Glugginn setur upp flýtilykil fyrir þetta — afhjúpun sem aðeins er hægt að ná með sveimi er afhjúpun sem lyklaborðsnotandi nær alls ekki til.

records.context: The event type is read first, and the liveness checks follow it. This filter is on the QApplication, so both `_still_alive` calls used to execute for every event in the process -- 94,431 of them during one Regression open, and a profile counted the pair at 839,906 calls in one Mask open. Reading the type of an object whose C++ half has gone raises, which the `except` below already answers with the same `False`, so the order costs nothing and the checks now run only for a context menu.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_dictionary.FeatureHelpFilter.eventFilter#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The event type is read first, and the liveness checks follow it. This filter is on the QApplication, so both `_still_alive` calls used to run for every event in the process -- 94,431 of them during one Regression open, and a profile counted the pair at 839,906 calls in one Mask open. Reading the type of an object whose C++ half has gone raises, which the `except` below already answers with the same `False`, so the order costs nothing and the checks now run only for a context menu.
records.translation: Gerð atburðarins er lesin fyrst, og lífsathuganirnar fylgja á eftir. Þessi sía er á QApplication, svo bæði `_still_alive` köllin keyrðu áður fyrir hvern atburð í ferlinu -- 94,431 þeirra við eina opnun Regression, og prófíll taldi parið 839,906 köll við eina opnun Mask. Að lesa gerð hlutar þar sem C++-helmingurinn er horfinn kastar villu, sem `except` hér að neðan svarar þegar með sama `False`, svo röðin kostar ekkert og athuganirnar keyra nú aðeins fyrir samhengisvalmynd.

records.context: That reveal is per setting. Pressing **Animation** on ``cell_diameter`` shows ``cell_diameter``'s animation and nothing else; move to the next setting and it is hidden again until its own **Animation** is pressed. A session-wide reveal was the obvious alternative and is exactly wrong for the machines this was asked for: one click would put every later hover back on the ~73 ms decode path for the rest of the processing session, which is the cost the change exists to avoid. Measured, the same sweep of 141 settings taken straight after a press: still 0 decodes.

records.context: The panel opens with the top hits selected: the top significant guides or genes and the microplate sample positions that carry them, which the user can change. The regression's results table gives the hits (:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`); without one, the guides of the montage's own groups are the selection. The population box then starts on "gRNAs + other datapoints in selected microplate sample positions", the derived microplate sample positions are shown under the controls, and "gRNAs…" / "selected wells…" change either. Nothing to select starts on "All datapoints", so a panel with no guides still draws what it drew before.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurement_compare_dialog.MeasurementComparePanel#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The panel opens with the top hits selected: the top significant guides or genes and the wells that carry them, which the user can change. The regression's results table gives the hits (:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`); without one, the guides of the montage's own groups are the selection. The population box then starts on "gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells", the derived wells are shown under the controls, and "gRNAs…" / "selected wells…" change either. Nothing to select starts on "All datapoints", so a panel with no guides still draws what it drew before.
records.translation: Glugginn opnast með efstu niðurstöðurnar valdar: efstu marktæku leiðsagnarraðirnar eða genin og brunnana sem bera þau, sem notandinn getur breytt. Niðurstöðutafla aðhvarfsins gefur niðurstöðurnar (:func:`spacr.well_scope._top_hits`); án hennar eru leiðsagnarraðir eigin hópa myndasamsetningarinnar valið. Þýðisreiturinn byrjar þá á "gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells", afleiddu brunnarnir eru sýndir undir stýringunum, og "gRNAs…" / "selected wells…" breyta hvoru tveggja. Ef ekkert er til að velja byrjar hann á "All datapoints", svo gluggi án leiðsagnarraða teiknar samt það sem hann teiknaði áður.

records.context: Colour: every colour painted here is derived from the theme that is on application view, never written as a literal, and the derivation preserves the relative luminance of the theme's own accent role. Contrast is a function of relative luminance and of nothing else, so a colour made this way clears exactly the contrast that the accent already clears on that theme, including the themes whose panels are translucent over a photograph. That is what lets an arbitrary number of barcode types each get a colour of their own without any of them becoming unreadable on any theme.

records.context: The difference from :meth:`add_widget` IS `_row_widgets`, and it is the whole reason this exists. Every entry there is taken to BE a labelled setting row by ``tests/qt/test_all_module_smoke.py::_setting_row_contract``, which asserts each field carries a ``settingKey`` and that its label is a QLabel holding linked API help. A prose box is neither a setting nor labelled, so registering it there would either fail that contract or force a fake ``settingKey`` onto a non-setting -- which would then be pushed into the tooltip and API-documentation machinery.

records.context: The ray from the centre, not the nearest edge. Projecting a point onto whichever edge happens to be closest is discontinuous along the diagonals: the pointer crosses one and the target jumps from the middle of the top edge to the middle of the left, which is what was reported as the rim being unsynced with the pointer inside the card. The point where the ray from the centre through the pointer leaves the rectangle moves continuously, and is always the place on the rim that is actually in the pointer's direction -- which is what "flows towards the mouse" has to mean if the mouse can be anywhere.

records.translation: GEISLINN FRÁ MIÐJUNNI, ekki næsta brún. Að varpa punkti á þá brún sem vill svo til að er næst er ósamfellt eftir hornalínunum: bendillinn fer yfir eina og markið stekkur frá miðju efri brúnar að miðju vinstri brúnar, sem er það sem var tilkynnt sem að jaðarinn væri ekki í takt við bendilinn innan spjaldsins. Punkturinn þar sem geislinn frá miðjunni í gegnum bendilinn fer út úr rétthyrningnum færist samfellt, og er alltaf sá staður á jaðrinum sem er í raun í stefnu bendilsins -- sem er það sem "flows towards the mouse" (flæðir í átt að músinni) verður að merkja ef músin getur verið hvar sem er.

records.source: So this shows the frames. One field plays as a movie; clicking it opens a filmstrip above, which is the same frames laid out at once and scrollable, because a break is easiest to find by scrubbing and easiest to *understand* by seeing the frames either side of it together.
records.translation: Því sýnir þetta rammana. Eitt sjónsvið spilast sem kvikmynd; smellur á hana opnar filmuræmu fyrir ofan, sem er sömu rammar lagðir út í einu og skrunanlegir, því auðveldast er að finna rof með því að fletta og auðveldast að *skilja* það með því að sjá rammana báðum megin við það saman.

records.context: Everything reuses the rendering already in :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview` -- ``render_frame`` colours mask outlines by track id and draws the trailing polyline, and ``track_colour`` is deterministic, so a colour identifies a track: an object that keeps its track id keeps its colour in every frame and in every thumbnail, so an identity swap reads as an object that changes colour partway through the strip.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_movie#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Everything reuses the rendering already in :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview` -- ``render_frame`` colours mask outlines by track id and draws the trailing polyline, and ``track_colour`` is deterministic, so a colour identifies a track: an object that keeps its track id keeps its colour in every frame and in every thumbnail, so an identity swap reads as an object that changes colour partway through the strip.
records.translation: Allt endurnýtir myndunina sem þegar er í :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview` -- ``render_frame`` litar útlínur grímna eftir auðkenni ferils og teiknar slóðarlínuna sem fylgir, og ``track_colour`` er löggengt, svo litur auðkennir feril: hlutur sem heldur auðkenni ferils síns heldur lit sínum í hverjum ramma og hverri smámynd, svo auðkennisskipti birtast sem hlutur sem skiptir um lit á miðri ræmunni.

records.context: **The style is a value.** Controls write into a :class:`~spacr.volcano_style.VolcanoStyle` and ask for a redraw. That makes the whole appearance saveable to JSON, reloadable, and reproducible.

records.source: **The style is a value.** Controls write into a :class:`~spacr.volcano_style.VolcanoStyle` and ask for a redraw. That makes the whole appearance saveable to JSON, reloadable, and reproducible.
